scope: Read-only isolation check of two actual release directories; no game, audio-equivalence or performance acceptance.

cache.headerFormula: SHA256(sorted absolute header path UTF-8 bytes + header contents, iterated in order; no separators)

disassembly.method: Read-only WAT disassembly; anchored instruction forms beginning with v128., i8x16., i16x8., i32x4., i64x2., f32x4. or f64x2.; no raw-byte 0xfd scan.

limitations: Final linker/Binaryen may reorder or optimize functions globally. Unrelated final function-byte equality is not an isolation requirement.
This evidence verifies build identity and generated instructions, not audio PCM equivalence or live 4x performance.
Invocation elapsed times are build bookkeeping, not game-performance measurements.
The previous disassembly was reused only after confirming the current final Wasm SHA values still exactly match the observed files.
